2125268106205364298.en_summary: Couzin_Vinny analyzes $MSFT with @spotgamma tools, watching the HEDGE WALL. As long as MSFT stays below $497.50, hedge wall dealers remain in negative gamma—upside moves can stall as dealers fade rallies toward $497.50–$500, and any drop back under $490 accelerates downside momentum. A sustained push above $497.50 and $500 flips dealers into net positive gamma. Clearing $500 triggers supportive dealer delta-hedging flows toward the $525 Call Wall (top gamma in Dec 18, 2026 and top delta in Jan 15, 2027).
2125268106205364298.zh_summary: Couzin_Vinny 使用 @spotgamma 工具分析 $MSFT，關注對沖牆。只要 MSFT 維持在 497.50 美元以下，對沖牆交易商保持負 gamma—上行可能停滯，因為交易商在向 497.50–500 美元反彈時淡出，任何跌回 490 美元以下都會加速下行動能。持續推升至 497.50 美元和 500 美元以上會將交易商翻轉為淨正 gamma。清除 500 美元會觸發支持性交易商 delta 對沖流向 525 美元看漲牆（最高 gamma 集中在 2026 年 12 月 18 日，最高 delta 在 2027 年 1 月 15 日）。

ticker_notes.MSFT: below $497.50 negative gamma, above $500 to $525 Call Wall

2125267735827423627.en_summary: RihardJarc fully agrees but thinks that if the gap between the frontier model that $ANT has vs others grows further and outside distillation is limited, $ANT can offer that best cheap model. Also there is a case that at each task if given the same price we would like a model even 0.1% better as 0.1% in each AI worker compounds on a company level.
2125267735827423627.zh_summary: RihardJarc 完全同意，但認為如果 $ANT 擁有的前沿模型與其他模型的差距進一步擴大且外部蒸餾受限，$ANT 可以提供最佳的廉價模型。此外，在每個任務中如果價格相同，我們會希望有一個甚至比其他同價模型好 0.1% 的模型，因為每個 AI 工人的 0.1% 會在公司層面複利。
